llm.note: Escalation only. Items scoring inside escalateBand get one cheap structured call. No web search tool is ever used - that is the expensive part.

polling._coldRotationNote: 200, raised from 19 on 2026-08-13. Measured rather than guessed: 10 real Google News county queries at the configured 1500ms spacing all returned 200 with a mean fetch of 0.35s, so a cold county costs about 1.85s. 200 is roughly 6.2 minutes of the run against a 20-minute workflow timeout - the previous 19 used 72 seconds of it. That turns a 21-day sweep of 3,231 counties into about 2 days, which matters now that the app tells a reader outright when their county has not been scanned yet. Raise further only after checking two things: the run stays well inside timeout-minutes in ingest.yml, and sourcesFailed in data/runs.json is not picking up google-news, which is what a rate limit looks like here.
